approach.method_basis: The Parent evolves scored molecular graphs through quantile-selected breeding, connected-fragment crossover and local atom/bond edits, with canonical identity and sulfur-admission checks. It keeps every accepted score for learning and a ranked survivor population for further breeding. At each purchase batch it fits a fixed gradient-boosted tree model to raw score differences from every ordered pair of accepted molecules. Each fresh candidate receives the earliest accepted incumbent score plus the predicted difference from that incumbent. A separate count-fingerprint Gaussian process supplies the correlated residuals added to these locations and the original mean ranking that restricts eligibility after stalled batches. Ten sequential maxima choose distinct purchases; only their real feedback changes later fits and breeding.
approach.novelty: Enforce reciprocity in this existing pair predictor at its location consumer: subtract the reverse prediction from the forward prediction, halve the result, and add the same incumbent score. This removes the symmetric component that the Parent measurably retains despite mirrored training pairs. The fitted trees, reference and Gaussian-process residual and eligibility rules stay fixed. There is no completed same-Parent sibling in the supplied evidence. The parallel sibling tests averaging over accepted references; this test keeps the original single reference. Corrected algebra must reach actual paid choices and then reduce error on the complete purchased stream; endpoint benefit is assessed separately.

observed_bottleneck: The limiting Parent behavior is inaccurate incumbent-referenced cardinal location despite complete exposure, with a measurable symmetric directional-error component that is left in its active predictions. Actual code Parent n-7e9f57600099 completed 435 fits and 4350 paid prediction/label joins, changed all 435 purchase sets versus its passive original GP and bought 2425 actual-only identities. Its all-paid MSE 0.009326712412663193 exceeds same-state GP 0.005240750463529221 in every one of 15 cells; tie-half paid ordering is 0.6348505085790609 versus 0.6911538066372136. Pool mean absolute diagonal and antisymmetry defects are 0.016086661654860494 and 0.022578409367158204. This is a refuted predictive mechanism, not failed execution. The frozen Search Policy audit, independently checked here against all original pre-feedback pool predictions and purchased outcomes, gives passive projected MSE 0.00873934661568698, lower than raw D in all 15 cells but still worse than GP in all 15. That retrospective signal supports this specific adjustment; it is neither an adaptive projected trial nor evidence that reciprocity repairs general predictive quality. The complete Parent observed macro mean/seed population SD are 0.5248434366619207/0.00869192547275882. Its frozen first comparison to formal Anchor n-cf8d309c06de remains paired_complete=false, matched_seeds=[], paired_mean_delta=null owing to the registered XGBoost lock addition; equal stage-profile hashes and the displayed arithmetic difference -0.08218687954921033 do not replace that certificate. Its finalized task_safe=false and ineligible status remain separate facts. Current Curate h-19f2d01cf07af401 preserves these distinctions. The source screen control n-c501ea219a1c supports retaining the original screen on its original Thompson host, not an interaction or contribution result for this cardinal host. Molecular large-tail and local-family concentration findings are descriptive and supply no second intervention. hypothesis: Apply exactly the frozen obstacle intervention on n-7e9f57600099. At every unchanged accepted cutoff, D(a,b) remains the same freshly fitted XGBoost 2.1.4 predictor of raw y_b-y_a from concatenated radius-2 chiral 2048-count fingerprints, using all ordered pairs including diagonals and every inherited setting. Let b be the unchanged earliest accepted serial attaining the maximum raw accepted score, fixed for the whole announcement. Reuse its existing native float32 forward f_x=D(b,x) and reverse r_x=D(x,b) outputs. Promote each operand separately to float64, compute a_x=(float64(f_x)-float64(r_x))*0.5, then mu_A(x)=float64(y_b)+a_x. The passive unchanged cardinal location is mu_D(x)=float64(y_b)+float64(f_x). The abstract corrected law is A(a,b)=(D(a,b)-D(b,a))/2; corrected self predictions use the same recorded D(a,a) twice, so A(a,a)=0, and opposite directions use swapped versions of the same two operands. No diagonal-only subtraction, reference average, clipping, location blend, calibration, tree/target/feature change or cycle-consistency solver enters the consumer. Active sampled values become mu_A[None,:]+R where R is the exact original count-GP correlated residual already computed once from the original normal block, factor and score scale. Preserve original GP fit, normalization, noise, covariance, factor/jitter, finite guard, normal call shape/order and original-GP-mean K3/M40 eligibility, exact ties and sequential availability. Passive mu_D+R and original mu_GP+R use separate private availability masks on this same Child state and the same gate; they receive no feedback or adaptive continuation. Extra arithmetic/diagnostics consume no RNG. The constraint removes a measured algebraic defect; it neither guarantees lower one-way incumbent-to-purchase error nor implies triangular consistency. The testable prediction is that complete correct, candidate-varying exposure reaching changed paid identities yields strictly smaller all-paid raw-score MSE for mu_A than mu_D on the actual Child stream. Original GP error and conditional endpoints remain independent readings.

finding_summary.headline: Reciprocity removes defects and slightly lowers paid error, but endpoint scores fall
finding_summary.insights:
Exact reciprocity is a working, narrowly useful prediction constraint, but it does not solve the remaining ranking problem. On the 737 purchases selected only after correction, projected MSE was 0.010977 versus 0.009981 for the unchanged directional prediction; the full-stream error benefit came from the 3,613 purchases shared with the passive rule. Those associations do not prove why endpoints fell, but they rule out interpreting the pooled MSE improvement as evidence that the changed purchases were better. The larger retrospective error reduction on the Parent’s old purchases also did not transfer at the same size to this new adaptive stream. The two borrowed TNNR arithmetic elements operated; neural training, all-reference averaging and cycle consistency were deliberately absent and remain untested.

Search continued to refine local analogue families: only 272 of 2,175 late purchases beat their generating parents, and fragment-excluded within-batch count similarity increased from 0.743529 to 0.757889 despite 2,059 typed scaffolds. The molecular assessment describes persistent oversized assemblies and unusual heteroatom-halogen decoration, while some leading cores broaden and others narrow. This supports local concentration and chemically demanding proposals, not universal scaffold collapse or a demonstrated chemical cause of the score loss. A different ranking or surrogate model could address the measured prediction mismatch; chemically coherent core and linker proposal operators could address limited local alternatives. This experiment does not decide which limitation controls the endpoint or whether the broader approach should continue.
finding_summary.results:
The registered paid-error prediction is confirmed. All 435 fits and pools ran correctly, and corrected self and opposite-direction defects were exactly zero. Candidate-varying corrections changed 357 purchase sets and 737 accepted identities relative to the passive directional rule. Across all 4,350 actual purchases, projected MSE was 0.00920670 versus 0.00927792 for that same-state directional baseline, a reduction of 0.00007123. All three seed means improved, but five of 15 task/seed cells worsened. The original GP remained more accurate in every cell, with pooled MSE 0.00534081. Paid ordering improved from 0.63440 to 0.64307 tie-half accuracy, still below GP 0.68501.

The separate endpoint target failed: mean finalTop1 was 0.520962 versus the code Parent’s 0.524843, a paired change of −0.003881 against the required +0.002. Five endpoint cells improved and ten declined; seed dispersion rose from 0.008692 to 0.019850. The mean DRD2 loss (−0.070734) exceeded the mean sitagliptin gain (+0.053542). All 15 tasks completed and every paid prediction joined real feedback, so this is neither technical nonexecution nor insufficient primary evidence. The formal Anchor’s 0.607030 mean remains a descriptive comparison because its lock differs; the original formal criterion is unchanged.

molecular.headline: Ring-rich analogues retain an oversized tail and reactive N/O-halogen decoration, with no specified stereochemistry
molecular.overall_character: All 15 Child and 15 published code-Parent trajectories were read for frozen Search seeds 0/1/2. Each node supplies 4,350 accepted optimizer purchases, separate from its initial observations; these files do not describe every unpurchased generated pool. No issued trajectory is missing. The frozen comparison explicitly has child_complete=true, paired_complete=true and matched_seeds=[0,1,2] against n-7e9f57600099. This is the current code-Parent pairing, not that Parent's older comparison or a newly certified formal-Anchor comparison. The output contains compact aromatic carbonyl compounds, huge heteroaryl/aryl-ether assemblies, aryl cyclic amines, fused cyclic amides and fluorinated N-rich polycycles. Rings and aromatic atoms are abundant: the task-level digest ring-closure rates are 0.9954 to 1.0 and aromatic-presence rates are 0.9851 to 1.0. These are text-presence rates, not fractions of atoms or proof of coherent ring geometry. Child median size is 33 heavy atoms, range 3-120, versus Parent median 32, range 2-120. For <=5, <=6, >=50 and >50 heavy atoms, Child counts are 3, 4, 857 and 848; Parent counts are 4, 4, 837 and 828. The upper tail is concentrated: one task supplies 783 of the Child's >=50-atom purchases. Tiny fragments are uncommon. The Child has 2,059 typed and 1,309 generic Murcko scaffolds, versus Parent 2,038 and 1,366, including the empty acyclic scaffold. Those counts describe graph variation, not independent synthetic chemotypes. Using the Parent audit's radius-2, chirality-aware 2,048-count Morgan dot-product Tanimoto definition, pair-count-weighted mean similarity within task/seed cells is 0.666076 for Child and 0.642373 for Parent; excluding <=6-heavy-atom structures gives 0.667255 and 0.643513. Within purchase batches the corresponding means are 0.756551 and 0.742229, or 0.757889 and 0.743529 after that exclusion. No cross-session molecular pairs enter those values. Broad aggregate scaffold variation thus coexists with concentrated local analogue families. The Child has 678 molecules with N-halogen bonds, 382 with O-halogen bonds and 62 with O-O bonds, compared with Parent 565, 63 and 175. These are structural flags; no stability, toxicity, synthetic route or biological utility has been measured here. No Child optimizer molecule specifies a tetrahedral configuration or double-bond geometry. RDKit finds 7,100 unassigned tetrahedral centres in 2,697 molecules. Only one molecule has formal atom charges, in a diazo-like charge-separated group; this does not establish systematic protonation-state coverage. Basic-amine-like environments, carbonyls and fluorinated carbons already occur, so they are not generically missing capabilities. Makeability remains questionable because unusual heteroatom bonds and crowded, small or bridged rings accompany familiar medicinal-chemistry motifs. All graph descriptors use RDKit 2023.09.6. The audit's small-ring flag counts perceived cycles of at most four atoms whose constituent atoms are aromatic-marked; it does not establish that every bond or the cycle itself is aromatic. Its broad [*]=[*]=[*] query also includes conventional heteroatom double-bond environments and is not treated as a count of reactive carbon cumulenes. The top-87 subsets below are the highest recorded optimizer scores within each task, with deterministic seed/evaluation tie handling; they are correlated descriptive subsets. Associations between chemistry and supplied scores do not identify an intervention mechanism or a component contribution. Source definitions, exact records, input mappings and byte hashes are in policy/scratch/r0072-00-improve-L01/molecular/chemistry-summary.json; the immutable context is policy/requests/r0072-00-improve-L01-molecular-assess-351f51c7b1cd82e6.json.

per_task.generated_character: The 870 purchases have 8-51 heavy atoms, median 26, and median three perceived rings. They chiefly develop carbonyl-linked aromatic systems: indole-like N-aryl carboxamides, aza-fused aryl ketones and sulfur/alkoxy-substituted variants. The seed-0 leader has 26 heavy atoms and three rings, an anilide, thiol, bromomethyl substituent and N-linked N(O)F group. Seed 1 reaches a 24-heavy-atom, three-ring aza-fused aryl ketone bearing N-N-Br; seed 2 reaches a 25-heavy-atom bridged/fused carboxamide with five perceived rings, including a four-membered cycle, methylthio and N-Cl. The top 87 span 26 typed/11 generic scaffolds versus Parent five/two at the same top-subset median size of 25 atoms. There is more leading-core variation than in the Parent, but the unusual decoration and ring junctions remain substantial makeability concerns. Parent seed leaders score 0.2339854106482522, 0.23272957867886357 and 0.22997883827444995.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Source n-93efcfa0f760, frozen Search seeds 0/1/2, batch ten, 290 accepted optimizer purchases per session; comparison is to issued code Parent n-7e9f57600099. Of 4,350 Child purchases, 857 have >=50 heavy atoms and 848 have >50, versus Parent 837 and 828. One covered series contributes 783 of the Child >=50 cases and its leading subset has median 97 heavy atoms. Other leading series remain compact. Only four Child purchases have <=6 heavy atoms. These are output descriptions under the complete current pairing, not attribution to an algorithm component.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator does not consistently express structural change without extensive growth of already large ring-rich molecules.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The missing capability is size-controlled core, ring and linker variation that preserves neighboring useful motifs without repeatedly concatenating large fragments. Let current-session feedback determine where such alternatives matter; this evidence supplies neither a universal size cutoff nor a new reward.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Source n-93efcfa0f760 under the same frozen three-seed, batch-ten Search panel and accepted-purchase scope. There are 678 molecules with N-halogen bonds, 382 with O-halogen bonds and 62 with O-O bonds; corresponding code-Parent counts are 565, 63 and 175. Actual leaders include N-brominated amino-heteroaromatics, an N-fluoro cyclic amidine-like motif carrying aryl-O-Cl, and a polycyclic compound with imino/amino N-F. These local structural flags persist at high supplied scores; they are not measured instability or toxicity outcomes.
transferable_gaps.gap: Chemically conventional bond environments are not reliably retained when the generator decorates otherwise recognizable molecular motifs.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: A task-agnostic generator needs chemically typed substitutions that preserve intact functional-group environments and can realize comparable ring/linker arrangements with conventional bonds. The proposed capability concerns chemical realization; no particular score gain or reward penalty follows from these associations.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Source n-93efcfa0f760, all 4,350 accepted optimizer purchases in the frozen Search panel. No assigned tetrahedral configuration or double-bond geometry is present. RDKit identifies 7,100 unassigned tetrahedral centres in 2,697 molecules. The sole structure with formal atom charges is diazo-like charge separation, rather than demonstrated protonation-state exploration. The code Parent likewise has no assigned tetrahedral or alkene geometry. These are missing representations in this output, not proof that the underlying string language cannot encode them or that a score must change.
transferable_gaps.gap: The realized output lacks explicit stereochemical and chemically relevant charge-state alternatives despite containing stereogenic and ionizable groups.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Preserve or deliberately vary chemically coherent configurations and charge states when edits create these distinctions. A neutral, unspecified graph should not stand in for evidence about one stereoisomer or solution-state form; current-session feedback must determine any optimization benefit.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Source n-93efcfa0f760, the same frozen accepted-purchase panel. 360 molecules have a perceived cycle of at most four atoms whose constituent atoms are aromatic-marked, versus Parent 131; this atom flag does not establish aromaticity of every cycle bond. 365 molecules have a perceived ring of at least nine atoms, versus Parent 560. Actual leaders include small fused unsaturated N-rings, three-membered N-rich cycles and densely bridged carbonyl frameworks. No conformer, strain or synthetic-route evidence was supplied, and unusual rings alone are not proof of impossibility.
transferable_gaps.gap: Ring novelty is generated without evidence that the resulting junctions and unsaturation can be realized as accessible molecular geometries.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Ring-forming and ring-replacing operations need chemically coherent size, junction, valence, unsaturation and stereochemical choices so that novel connectivity can have plausible realizations. This is not justification for forbidding ring-rich molecules or claiming an unmeasured score contribution.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Source n-93efcfa0f760, same frozen Search panel; comparison to n-7e9f57600099 uses the same descriptor definitions. Child totals are 2,059 typed/1,309 generic Murcko scaffolds versus Parent 2,038/1,366, including the empty scaffold. After excluding <=6-heavy-atom molecules, mean within-batch count Tanimoto is 0.757889 versus Parent 0.743529. Exact-score terminal-halogen and peripheral-unsaturation variants occur among cited high-score molecules. Some leading core sets broaden while others narrow, so this is local concentration, not universal collapse. Chemistry association is not component attribution.
transferable_gaps.gap: Aggregate scaffold variety does not consistently provide distinct, chemically plausible alternatives within the leading local analogue families.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The generator needs access to coherent core and linker alternatives that preserve useful functional-group arrangements, alongside local atom decoration. Neither scaffold counts nor similarity alone establish chemical utility, justify a diversity reward, or identify which search component should change.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
